text: “I see Lord Caterham and Bundle strolling together. The first thing to do is to find out definitely whether the dead man is Michael or not.” Anthony paddled to shore and a few moments later they had joined Lord Caterham and his daughter. “Lunch is late,” said his lordship in a depressed voice. “Battle has insulted the cook, I expect.” “This is a friend of mine, Bundle,” said Virginia. “Be nice to him.” Bundle looked earnestly at Anthony for some minutes, and then addressed a remark to Virginia as though he had not been there.
